summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥130/share (Q2 ¥55 + FY-end ¥75) from prior guidance ¥110/share. Payout ratio target increased from 40% to 50%; DOE floor lifted from 4% to 5%+. Effective FY12/26.
title_en: Notice on Dividend Policy Change and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
KH Neochem announced on 4 August 2026 a revision to its dividend policy and FY12/26 dividend forecast. The annual dividend guidance for the fiscal year ending December 2026 has been raised to ¥130 per share (comprising Q2 interim dividend of ¥55 and FY-end dividend of ¥75), up from the prior forecast of ¥110 per share issued on 11 May 2026. This represents a FY-end dividend increase of ¥20 per share (from ¥55 to ¥75).

Concurrently, the company updated its dividend policy effective FY12/26. The consolidated payout ratio target has been raised from a target of 40% to 50%; the dividend on equity (DOE) floor has been increased from 4%+ to 5%+. The policy change reflects management's commitment to improving capital efficiency and strengthening profit return to shareholders while maintaining a balance between organic growth investment and shareholder distributions. The new guidance supersedes the forecast announced on 11 May 2026.
